purpose: Lightweight two-room mixed-mode smoke with one synthetic Opus/VP8 host, one actual watch receiver, and one interaction-only participant per room.

tls.trust: local CA imported only into isolated Firefox NSS profiles; certificate errors are not ignored

topology.network: one externally running managed local HTTPS/WSS application

credentials.hostToken: provided in process memory; value not recorded
credentials.roomPassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded
credentials.resumeTokens: observed only as presence flags; values not retained

syntheticSources.audio: one per-room host oscillator routed through AudioContext MediaStreamDestination; no physical microphone
syntheticSources.video: one per-room host animated canvas returned by test-only getDisplayMedia replacement; no physical display capture

limits.sampling: Three 400 ms sample intervals; counters are local or server enqueue observations, not p95, end-to-end latency, or quality results.
limits.transport: Per-receiver server downlink is a connection-lifetime WebSocket enqueue counter; browser binary bytes and render counters are separately observed.
limits.devices: No phone, physical microphone, physical display, human listening, real backgrounding, weak-network shaping, capacity, durability, or Cloud Run result.
limits.productStatus: This short feasibility smoke does not establish full POC-05 completion or deployment readiness.
